description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for reading news articles with additional features like text-to-speech, sharing, browsing, and saving articles. It manages webview display and TTS configurations, as well as user interactions via app bar actions and popup menus.

classes.name: ReadArticleArgs
classes.description: A simple class encapsulating the arguments (news article) passed to the ReadArticleScreen.

classes.name: ReadArticleScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a news article in a WebView and provides features for speech synthesis, sharing, saving, and browsing.

classes.name: _ListenMenuButton
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that provides a popup menu button for controlling TTS playback, speed, and voice selection.

methods.name: _configureTts
methods.description: Asynchronously configures the text-to-speech engine with language and speech rate settings.

methods.name: _handleMoreAction
methods.description: Handles actions from the 'More' menu: sharing, saving, and browsing the article.

methods.name: _ttsText
methods.description: Prepares the text to be spoken by TTS, including a paywall message.

methods.name: _play
methods.description: Triggers TTS to read aloud the article content.

methods.name: _applyRateAndPlay
methods.description: Applies a new speech rate and restarts TTS playback.

methods.name: _applyVoiceAndPlay
methods.description: Sets a new voice for TTS and starts playback.
